title: OCI Audit Failures
description: Alert-ready aggregation of OCI Audit control-plane operations whose parsed Status is Failure. This is a field-backed approximation of the referenced Splunk message-text search: it preserves failed 4xx/5xx activity but does not independently classify throttling when the parser does not expose it as Failure.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Audit Logs' and Status = 'Failure' | stats count as AuditFailures, earliest(Time) as FirstSeen, latest(Time) as LastSeen by 'Event Type', 'User Name', Status | sort -AuditFailures
